exportd

MixOS keeps every desktop setting in settingsd. A desk that runs a foreign desktop (COSMIC, Plasma) or foreign toolkits (GTK, Qt) gets the same look through an exporter: a Mix Bus citizen that follows the settings topics and writes the foreign desktop's own config. The export is one way. settingsd is the source; a change made in the foreign desktop's own settings app is overwritten at the next revision, and nothing is read back.

Every exporter:

  • reconciles once when it connects, then writes each revision's changed keys in one burst, with no polling;
  • writes only the keys it owns, and only where the contents differ;
  • keeps the contents it replaced, so one command undoes it;
  • stops writing while its gate is false: appearance.export_desktop for the desktops, appearance.export_toolkits for GTK and Qt.

Colours and fonts come from settings.palette, the derived palette settingsd computes; an exporter names them and computes none.

COSMIC

scripts/cosmic.mix writes a COSMIC desktop's cosmic-config tree ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cosmic, one RON file per key). cosmic-comp, the panel and every libcosmic app watch those files, so the desktop follows at once.

mix --serve <prefix>/lib/exportd/cosmic.mix --name exportd-cosmic

The unit exportd-cosmic@.service runs it in a session, as that session's user.

What it writes

Settingscosmic-config
appearance.mode (resolved; auto is settingsd's)com.system76.CosmicTheme.Mode v1 is_dark; auto_switch always false
the palette, appearance.contrast, accent, tints, backgroundsboth builders (com.system76.CosmicTheme.Dark.Builder, .Light.Builder v2) and both derived themes (.Dark, .Light v2): every container, component, the 32-colour palette, accent text, shade
appearance.roundness, appearance.densityboth builders' and themes' corner_radii, spacing; com.system76.CosmicTk v1 interface_density, header_size; the panel and dock radius, padding and spacing
appearance.frosted.*frosted, alpha_map, frosted_windows, frosted_system_interface, frosted_panel, frosted_applets
window.active_hint, window.hint_colour, window.gapsactive_hint, window_hint, gaps (the inner gap at least the hint width)
window.hint_shown, window.clip_*, window.shadow_tiled, window.edge_gravity, focuscom.system76.CosmicComp v1 active_hint, appearance_settings, edge_snap_threshold, focus_follows_cursor, focus_follows_cursor_delay, cursor_follows_focus
appearance.font_family, mono_family, icon_theme, window.controls.*CosmicTk v1 interface_font, monospace_font, icon_theme, show_minimize, show_maximize; apply_theme_global always false (MixOS's own GTK and Qt export does that work)
shell.panels.top, .bottomcom.system76.CosmicPanel.Panel and .Dock v1, and which of them com.system76.CosmicPanel v1 entries lists
wallpaper.*com.system76.CosmicBackground v1 all, same-on-all and one key per output

The fonts are the palette's too: the families MixOS draws, the session's choice or the bundled Inter and JetBrains Mono (COSMIC takes the family alone; it has no size setting). Panel applet lists and the wallpaper are written only once MixOS has its own; until then COSMIC keeps its own.

Each key is replaced atomically (a .atomicwrite temporary, then a rename), builders before themes and the mode last, so a mode flip lands on two complete themes.

Commands

CommandRequest and reply
exportd.cosmic.status→ {binding, root, revision, paused, dry_run, last}
exportd.cosmic.plan→ {changed: [path], unchanged}: what an export would write; writes nothing
exportd.cosmic.reconcileexport now; clears a pause
exportd.cosmic.undo{to: "previous" | "original"} → {restored, to, paused}: every key back to its contents before the latest write, or before the first; exporting then pauses until reconcile
exportd.cosmic.owned→ {paths}: every key file it has written

Environment

VariableDefault
MIXOS_SETTINGS_INSTANCE, MIXOS_SETTINGS_PROFILEthe hostname, default (the profile must be default)
MIXOS_SETTINGS_SERVICEsettingsd
MIXOS_EXPORTD_COSMIC_ROOT$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cosmic
MIXOS_EXPORTD_STATE$XDG_STATE_HOME/mixos/exportd/cosmic (undo and pause)
MIXOS_EXPORTD_DRY_RUN=1plan only: log what would change, write nothing

GTK and Qt

scripts/gtkqt.mix (--name exportd-gtkqt, unit exportd-gtkqt@.service) writes GTK CSS and settings.ini keys and the qt5ct/qt6ct colour schemes and config on every desk but a KDE Plasma one, where the KDE export covers GTK and Qt. Its commands are exportd.gtkqt.status, .reconcile and .undo. The GTK and Qt page has the details.
